settlements.justice.plead.fine: All right, %s, no stocks. But you'll pay the fine.

settlements.justice.bribe.ok: ...I saw nothing, %s. And you never saw me. Off with you.
settlements.justice.bribe.no: Bribing the watch, %s? That will cost you.
settlements.elder.story.open.small.0: Hardly a village, %1$s... a hamlet. %2$s souls, children counted. But we hold on.
settlements.elder.story.open.small.1: There aren't many of us in %1$s yet, just %2$s. Everyone counts, everyone works for two.
settlements.elder.story.open.growing.0: %1$s is growing, bit by bit. %2$s of us now, and I remember when we were five.
settlements.elder.story.open.growing.1: We get by, no complaints. %2$s people in %1$s, and each with work to do.
settlements.elder.story.open.thriving.0: You wouldn't know %1$s now: %2$s souls, and people come to us of their own accord.
settlements.elder.story.open.thriving.1: Can't complain. %2$s people in %1$s, trade going, houses going up.
settlements.elder.story.open.poor.0: It's hard for us, I'll be honest. %2$s people in %1$s, and the land here is mean.
settlements.elder.story.open.poor.1: Not the best of times for %1$s. %2$s mouths, and not easy to feed.
settlements.elder.story.food.plenty.0: Bread enough: %s knows the work, the granary's full.
settlements.elder.story.food.plenty.1: We eat well, can't complain. %s's field yields like a dream.
settlements.elder.story.food.ok.0: Food enough for now, but nothing put by. %s is in the field from dawn to dusk.
settlements.elder.story.food.ok.1: We eat our fill, but there's nothing to spare. It all rests on the harvest, on %s.
settlements.elder.story.food.short.0: Bread is short. The granary's near empty, and %s can't do it alone.
settlements.elder.story.food.short.1: Food is scarce, people go hungry. One field, and only %s working it.
settlements.elder.story.food.none.0: There's nothing to eat, that's what. The granary's empty, and in the field: %s.
settlements.elder.story.food.none.1: We're starving. Not a crumb in the stores, and the field hasn't given yet. %s works it.
settlements.elder.story.build.start.0: %s has just started on the %s; so far just the marking out and the first logs.
settlements.elder.story.build.start.1: We've set our minds on a %2$s. %1$s has begun, but there's a world of work to do.
settlements.elder.story.build.mid.0: %s is putting up the %s, half done already. You can see the walls from the road.
settlements.elder.story.build.mid.1: We're building a %2$s. %1$s works dawn to dusk; by the week's end, perhaps.
settlements.elder.story.build.end.0: %s has nearly finished the %s; not much left, come and have a look later.
settlements.elder.story.build.end.1: The %2$s will soon be done, %1$s is seeing to the last of it.
settlements.elder.story.build.idle.0: Nothing to build just now; %s mends what we have and lays the roads.
settlements.elder.story.build.idle.1: No new building for the moment. %s isn't idle, but we're waiting for materials.
settlements.elder.story.short.planks: We're short of wood, the building stalls.
settlements.elder.story.short.planks.who: We're short of wood. %s fells what they can, but it's one against a forest.
settlements.elder.story.short.cobble: No stone, that's the trouble. We've no mason; it gets broken between other jobs.
settlements.elder.story.short.cobble.who: Stone is short. %s is at the quarry, but stone doesn't come quick.
settlements.elder.story.short.iron: We lack iron. Without it, no tools, no hinges for the doors.
settlements.elder.story.short.wool: No wool; nothing to stuff the beds with, and folk want to sleep warm.
settlements.elder.story.short.food: And above all, food. Nobody works on an empty stomach.
settlements.elder.story.short.meat: We haven't seen meat in a long while; bread alone won't do.
settlements.elder.story.mood.grief: These aren't happy days... we buried one of our own not long ago. People are quiet.
settlements.elder.story.mood.fear: People are frightened: we were attacked not long ago. In the evenings nobody goes out.
settlements.elder.story.mood.joy: We're glad: we've just finished a building, the whole village went to look.
settlements.elder.story.end.fine: That's how we live. Come by any time, you're welcome here.
settlements.elder.story.end.help.planks: If you could bring logs or planks to the stores, you'd help us a lot.
settlements.elder.story.end.help.cobble: Bring us stone and we'll never forget it.
settlements.elder.story.end.help.iron: If you have iron, bring it; we'll pay what we can.
settlements.elder.story.end.help.wool: Wool, if you find any, would be a great help.
settlements.elder.story.end.help.food: If you can spare food, bring it to the stores; folk will thank you.
settlements.elder.story.end.help.meat: Bring meat, and the tavern will pour you a drink.
settlements.news.arrival: A newcomer has come to live with us: %s.
settlements.news.arrival.couple: A family has come to live with us: %s.
settlements.news.left: %s has left us; couldn't bear the hunger.
settlements.elder.welcome: We've a newcomer: %s. There's room, let them stay.
settlements.elder.welcome.couple: A family has come to us: %s. Welcome, there's work for all.

settlements.say.rogue.stocks.1.f: I didn't take anything... well, hardly.

settlements.news.rogue.caught: %s was caught stealing from the stores and is in the stocks.

settlements.news.rogue.helped: An accomplice caught: %s was helping a prisoner (%s) escape.
settlements.news.crime.vanished: In the morning the stocks were empty: the prisoner (%s) was long gone.
settlements.say.work.miller: Off to the mill, the grain's waiting.
settlements.say.work.miller.f: Off to the mill, the grain's waiting.
settlements.say.work.collier: Time to see to the charcoal pit.
settlements.say.work.collier.f: Time to see to the charcoal pit.

settlements.say.merchant.call.f: Wool, bread, firewood: come and see!
settlements.say.merchant.call.2: Hey, traveller! Look what I've got.
settlements.say.merchant.call.2.f: Hey, traveller! Look what I've got.

settlements.say.heal.sick.f: Here, %s, drink this. You'll be up tomorrow.

settlements.say.fest.sermon.f: Brothers and sisters, let us give thanks for the harvest and our bread.

settlements.say.bearing.armour.1.f: In armour round the village... not too hot?
settlements.say.bearing.armour.2: And who might this grand visitor be?

settlements.news.rogue.caught.purse: %s was caught robbing %s and stands in the stocks now.
settlements.news.harvest.bad: A bad week for the fields: the harvest is poor, bread will be short.
settlements.news.refused.food: %s has full granaries, but wouldn't sell us bread - we've nothing to pay with. People are angry.
settlements.news.trade.credit: Bought %2$s from %1$s, part of it on credit: %3$s nuggets.
settlements.news.trade.lent: Sold %2$s to %1$s, part of it on credit: %3$s nuggets.
settlements.news.debt.paid: We've paid off what we owed %s. A weight off our shoulders.
settlements.news.debt.repaid: %s has paid back what they owed us in full.
settlements.news.debt.overdue: %s still hasn't paid back what they owe (%s nuggets). How long are we to wait?
settlements.elder.story.friend: We get along well with %s: we trade, we help each other out.
settlements.elder.story.cold: Things are strained with %s. They look at us askance.
settlements.elder.story.enemy: And with %s it's a real feud. Any day now they'll come at us with axes.
settlements.elder.story.weowe: We owe %s %s nuggets, and the debt weighs on us.
settlements.news.market.stone: Bought a cartload of stone from passing traders.
settlements.news.market.wood: Bought logs for the building from passing traders.
settlements.justice.search.ask.cold: Hold it, %s. Turn out your pockets, now. And no tricks.
settlements.justice.search.clean.cold: Clean... this time, %s. Don't think I'll take my eyes off you.

settlements.justice.found.hall.f: The stores in the hall are empty! Someone's carried off the village's goods! Guards!

settlements.justice.stocks.struggle.caug: Sit still, %s! Another half minute for that.
